label: About
title: About Salmon Threshold Cutaway
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 527 recent saved-signal files and 158 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @archaeologyart: Dog with a Biscuit and a Chinese Cup by Giovanna Garzoni, 1640s and @cerebras: Cerebras is now running Kimi K2.6 – a trillion parameter model – in enterprise..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Salmon Threshold Cutaway: Architectural section, low frontal camera plate grammar: a thick dusty salmon tabletop becomes a public threshold cutaway beneath a smoky charcoal void and granular dark upper band. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against lower salmon apron slab, cyan desk insert, and central white paper strata.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
